description: Explicit metric-policy overrides for the committed Olist analysis fixtures.

policies.valid_completed_order: An order is completed when order_status equals delivered.
policies.default_business_time: Use the purchase/order event as the default reporting time unless the user explicitly requests another business event.
policies.order_level_payment_aggregation: For order-level payment metrics, aggregate payment rows by order_id before joining them to order-level data.

ecommerce.payment_gmv.default_population: Orders satisfying the Olist valid_completed_order policy.

ecommerce.aov.default_population: Orders satisfying the Olist valid_completed_order policy.
ecommerce.aov.denominator_policy: Count distinct completed order_id values in the same population as the payment amount numerator; preserve completed orders until the denominator is calculated.

ecommerce.delivery_rate.denominator_policy: Count all distinct orders in the analysis period before applying completed-status filters or payment joins.

ecommerce.payment_method_amount_share.default_population: Payment rows belonging to orders satisfying the Olist valid_completed_order policy.

ecommerce.multi_payment_order_rate.default_population: Orders with payment rows that also satisfy the Olist valid_completed_order policy.
